title: Common Ground, Diverse Roots: The Difficulty of Classifying Common Examples in Spanish Varieties

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance and training dynamics (using Datamaps to track prediction confidence and variability) on hard-to-classify 'common examples' across different Spanish dialects (e.g., Cuban, Argentinian, Spain), and using SHAP analysis to identify how region-specific topics and named entities influence model misclassifications.
